overview: The Commission approved several one-day licenses and a new permanent Wine, Malt, and Cordials license for Localito LLC in Medford Square. The board also elected Robert Delafano as its new chair and updated the official application form for temporary licenses.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the approval of minutes from the meeting held on May 15, 2024.

items.title: D1 Soccer League One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Tabled two license requests for games and musical performances at Hormel Stadium to allow for a departmental review of logistical requirements.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for a music festival on September 15 and Run Medford events on September 27 and 28.

items.title: Eventham Studios One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for a gaming tournament on June 28 and a performance in collaboration with JJ Gonson on June 29.

items.title: Riverside Yacht Club One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a social event on September 7, subject to the applicant submitting a site diagram.

items.title: Boston Glory One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a playoff game scheduled for either July 27 or August 11.

items.title: Localito LLC New License Application
items.summary: Approved a new Wine, Malt, and Cordials license for Localito LLC at 30 Riverside Ave, contingent on the submission of a menu.

items.title: Hormel Stadium Logistics Discussion
items.summary: Recreation Director Kevin Bailey provided an update on the coordination required for upcoming events at Hormel Stadium.

items.title: One-Day License Application Form Revision
items.summary: Approved a revised one-day license application form that includes sections for fee tracking and rain dates.

items.title: Election of Commission Chair
items.summary: Elected Robert Delafano to serve as the Chair of the Licensing Commission starting in the new fiscal year.

items.title: Alcohol Compliance Check Discussion
items.summary: Discussed the preliminary results of citywide compliance checks and the scheduling of potential hearings for September.
